reason: A offers a more physically grounded and discriminating proposal: Cr-induced ferromagnetic/antiferromagnetic nanoscale heterogeneity is a plausible pinning mechanism supported by prior Cr-containing alloy observations, and it can be tested against both FeCoNi and Pd/Pt baselines with correlated microscopy and coercivity measurements. B is comparatively speculative, provides no supporting evidence, and inconsistently requires single-phase fcc retention while attributing hardening to poorly defined heterogeneity or exchange bias.
